answer.rationale: Routing read queries to replicas (memory_b5) previously reduced primary database load and enabled transactional write latency to recover within the same operational day. This is an immediate, compliance-safe intervention that can be applied without reverting the mandatory security patch. While the current degradation is write-path focused, memory_b5 demonstrates that reducing read load on the primary can indirectly restore write performance during peak traffic. Verifying memory_b3 (add_capacity) as a secondary option, but read offloading is faster to execute and has direct precedent for improving write latency.
